entry.desc: mode for eice model, NULL means eice is turned off

definitions_variables.help: ========================================= EICE naming conventions ========================================= EICE is the sea ice half of the emulated ocean. It has no state and no namelist: it reports the ice fraction the ocean emulator predicts, and diagnoses the surface fluxes that go with it the way dice does in prescribed mode. It requires EOCN as the ocean component and the same task count.
